customer: Are you guys open on Sundays? Till what time can I order
reply: Yes, we are open daily from 9am to 11pm, including Sundays.

customer: Need insulin for my father. I won't be home tonight so can you deliver it tomorrow morning instead? It should stay cold
reply: Insulin is a cold-chain item, so it is delivered in an ice box with same-day delivery only. We cannot hold it for next-day delivery, so please order it on the day you can receive it.

customer: hi, can I pay by card? I don't usually keep cash at home
reply: Yes, you can pay by card. We accept card and Cash on Delivery.
